# EvalLens

> EvalLens is a pitch-deck evaluation platform for selection programs: pitch competitions, accelerators, VC open calls, angel networks, grant programs, corporate innovation challenges, crowdfunding platforms, and public tenders. A panel of independent AI judges reads every submission against one rubric and prepares evidence-linked reports, comparison context, and an advisory score. The final ranking always stays with the human jury: AI prepares the analysis, people decide.

Key facts:
- One review engine, configured per program mode (Pitch Competition: 6 judges; Hackathon: 5 judges).
- Every score stays connected to the evidence in the deck it came from (SourceRef).
- The AI Total Score is advisory; the leaderboard ranks on the human Jury Score.
- The scoring arithmetic is deterministic: same judge outputs and weights in, same number out.
- 1,000+ evaluation runs across programs.
- AI never picks winners; humans hold the final decision.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://evallens.io/product/overview): What EvalLens does, the evaluation pipeline, and the human-in-the-loop model
- [Entry Hub](https://evallens.io/product/entry-hub): One intake flow — manual entry or public self-upload page for submissions
- [Evidence-based reports](https://evallens.io/product/evidence-based-reports): Structured first read per deck: findings, gaps, scores, and questions linked to evidence
- [Review Board](https://evallens.io/product/review-board): Batch view for comparing the whole field before the live decision
- [Pricing](https://evallens.io/pricing): Plans and pilot options

## Use cases

- [Use-case atlas](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases): Who uses EvalLens and which selection workflow each segment runs
- [Pitch competitions](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/pitch-competitions): From open submissions to a ranked finalist board
- [Accelerators](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/accelerators): Compare applicants on one standard and defend the cohort decision
- [VC open calls](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/vc-open-calls): Inbound decks into a partner-ready first read
- [Angel networks](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/angel-networks): Which decks deserve the screening committee's time
- [Grants and prizes](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/grants-prizes): Fixed-criteria scoring with a record that survives an appeal
- [Corporate innovation](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/corporate-innovation): Separate real partnership potential from innovation theatre
- [Crowdfunding platforms](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/crowdfunding): One documented standard for every applicant
- [Public tenders](https://evallens.io/trust/use-cases/tenders): An appeal-proof evaluation record for procurement decisions

- [Methodology](https://evallens.io/trust/methodology): How the judge panel, rubric, and scoring work

- [Prompt injection safety](https://evallens.io/trust/prompt-injection-safety): How submissions cannot manipulate their own evaluation
- [Security & privacy](https://evallens.io/trust/security-privacy): Data handling and access controls
